title: Frontend notice for video data restoration after upgrade issue

requirements.summary: Display a dismissible notice banner on Home and Video Gallery pages informing users that a technical issue occurred during the latest update and video restoration is in progress
acceptanceCriteria: A dismissible banner or alert is shown at the top of the Home page and Video Gallery page
The banner communicates clearly that a technical issue may have affected video visibility
The banner is easy to remove from the codebase once the issue is resolved

file_operations.description: Create a dismissible alert banner component that displays a clear message about the technical issue affecting video visibility during the Version 35 update. The banner should include an info icon, a concise message explaining that video restoration is in progress, and a close button that persists the dismissal state in localStorage to prevent repeated displays. Style using shadcn/ui Alert component with appropriate info variant and dismissible behavior.
Import and render the DataRestorationBanner component at the top of the Home page, above the video grid. Position the banner to be clearly visible when users land on the home page.
Import and render the DataRestorationBanner component at the top of the Video Gallery page, above the search input and video grid. Ensure consistent placement with the Home page implementation.
